title: Products and Factorisation
seo_title: Grade 10 Products and Factorisation Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Products: multiplication of a binomial by a trinomial; factorisation: revise common factors (Grade 9), factorisation of trinomials, factorisation by grouping in pairs, sums and differences of two cubes.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 10 worksheets: products of polynomials, common factors, trinomials, difference of two squares, sum and difference of cubes and grouping. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Take out the highest common factor first.
  • Trinomial ax² + bx + c: find factors of ac that add up to b.
  • Difference of two squares: a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b).
  • Cubes: a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²) and a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²).

Examples

Example

8x³ − 27

(2x)³ − 3³

Answer: (2x − 3)(4x² + 6x + 9)

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
The middle term(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b².
SignsCheck by expanding.
Cube signsThe middle sign in the trinomial is the opposite.

items.q: Factor out the greatest common factor: 3x3 + 3x2 + 21x.
items.e: The GCF of the numbers is 3 and every term has x. Divide every term by 3x: 3x(x2 + x + 7).
